name: Box Dips
cardText:
Box Dips
Intermediate
1
Hold your body with arms locked above the equipment
2
Lower your body slowly while leaning forward, flare out your elbows
3
Raise your body above the bars until your arms are locked.

name: Incline Push Up
cardText:
Incline Push Up
Beginner
1
Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform.
2
Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.
3
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the bench.
4
Push body up until arms are extended.

name: Decline Push Up
cardText:
Decline Push Up
Beginner
1
Use a bench to elevate your feet.
2
Put your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the ground
4
Raise your body until you almost lock your elbows.

name: Diamond Push Ups
cardText:
Diamond Push Ups
Beginner
1
Position your index fingers and thumbs so they are touching, forming a diamond shape
2
Use a standard push up position
3
Lower your chest towards your hands, keep your elbows close to your body
4
Stop just before your chest touches the floor, then push back up to the starting position.

name: Bench Dips
cardText:
Bench Dips
Novice
1
Grip the edge of the bench with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
2
Lower your body straight down.
3
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
4
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

name: Ring Skullcrusher
cardText:
Ring Skullcrusher
Beginner
1
Attach the ring straps to a high point. Stand on your tip toes.
2
Your arms should be extended in front of you.
3
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps. Then extend your elbows back to the start.

name: Ring Standing Archer Pushup
cardText:
Ring Standing Archer Pushup
Intermediate
1
Position rings shoulder-width apart, grasp handles, extend legs behind.
2
Lower chest to rings, bend one elbow, while extending your other arm out to the side. Push yourself back to the start.
3
Then switch arms and repeat.

name: Ring Standing Pushup
cardText:
Ring Standing Pushup
Beginner
1
Start by setting up the rings to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
2
Stand facing the rings grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
3
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
4
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
cardText:
Parallel Bar Dips
Intermediate
1
Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
2
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
3
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Bodyweight Box Assisted Dips
cardText:
Bodyweight Box Assisted Dips
Novice
1
Grip the edge of the boxes with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
2
Lower your body straight down.
3
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
4
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension
cardText:
Bodyweight Tricep Extension
Intermediate
1
Begin in a plank position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
2
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Knee Tricep Extension
cardText:
Bodyweight Knee Tricep Extension
Beginner
1
Begin in kneeling position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
2
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Knee Push Ups
cardText:
Bodyweight Knee Push Ups
Novice
1
Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
2
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
3
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Incline Knee Push Up
cardText:
Bodyweight Incline Knee Push Up
Novice
1
Start by placing two boxes (or one) on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
2
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the box, keeping your arms straight.
3
Put your knees on the floor.
4
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the box.
5
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Bodyweight Explosive Push Up
cardText:
Bodyweight Explosive Push Up
Advanced
1
Start in a push-up position.
2
Lower your chest, explode up.
3
Land softly, repeat for reps.

name: Bodyweight Elevated Push Up
cardText:
Bodyweight Elevated Push Up
Intermediate
1
Start by placing two plates or low boxes on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
2
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the boxes/plates, keeping your arms straight.
3
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
4
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
5
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Bodyweight Diamond Knee Push Ups
cardText:
Bodyweight Diamond Knee Push Ups
Novice
1
Begin in a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
2
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
3
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Clapping Push Up
cardText:
Bodyweight Clapping Push Up
Intermediate
1
Start in a push-up position.
2
Lower your chest, explode up, clap hands.
3
Land softly, repeat for reps.
